key_insight: MOTIF improves out-of-distribution materials property prediction by using LLMs to propose chemical taxonomies rather than predict numerical properties directly.
engineering_relevance: More robust predictions across unfamiliar material families could support perovskite screening, with transfer evaluated on 3D perovskite solar cell efficiencies.
method: Generate candidate material taxonomies with LLMs.
Retain taxonomies that improve training-only pseudo-OOD validation, then select invariant features.
Combine predictions through gated aggregation across accepted taxonomies.
evidence_signal: On 2D halide perovskites, mean OOD bandgap MAE fell from 0.122 to 0.111 eV; frozen dev/test evaluation reduced electronic and optical bandgap errors from 0.123 to 0.117 eV and 0.181 to 0.173 eV, respectively.
watch_item: Gains are benchmark-dependent, and taxonomy selection must remain isolated from test data to avoid leakage.
paper_title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
